findings.summary: Avatar.Fallback with an explicit delay prop also delays the fallback when there is no image or it failed. m3 passes no delay, so the fallback shows immediately.
Avatar mix-blend-mode flashes on window resize in Chrome. The class is identical in the radix-nova and base-nova files, so it is not a Radix-to-Base difference.
Fallback flash for cached images on SSR hydration; fixed (PR 4469). Other avatar issues (5379, 5529, 4109) are closed.

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog search
Image load-failure fallback in the browser (gallery has no broken-image case)

apiChanges: Import switches from radix-ui to @base-ui/react/avatar; prop types become AvatarPrimitive.*.Props. Radix Fallback delayMs becomes Base UI delay; no consumer uses it.
notes: Registry diff radix-nova vs base-nova is import and type lines only. Compared reference and local at 1280 wide: screenshots look identical; DOM, attributes, rects, background and font size of every avatar part match. 390x844 not checked: resize_window did not change the viewport (innerWidth stayed 1280); the avatar row has no responsive classes. Consumers needed no edits (no asChild). Only data attribute order differs.
